text: It's free, you can track lots of habits, see the statistics, and now even log each day of the habit. I really like the grid visualization, being able to see the week, the month and the year. For me visualization of progress or lack of it is what really helps in habit trackers. I do think some tweaks here and there would make it better, like accessing the statistics directly on the habit and having more statistics. But the dev is very receptive of feedback, so definitely give it a try.
author: TheNerdZuero
developer_reply: Thank you so much for your review! I’ll definitely take your suggestion about easier access to statistics and more insights into consideration for future updates. I appreciate you sharing your feedback!
